author: GameTrailers
description:
This summer, The MIX takes a deep dive into showcasing dope indie titles that push the boundaries of creativity, visual style, in various genres.

#IGN #Gaming
title: The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Azula Developer Overview for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game (working title), an upcoming 2D anime action fighting game based on the hit Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. 
Players can check out the developer-led rundown on Azula's gameplay mechanics to best utilize both of the princess's stances, air dashes, and flaming traps. Turn up the heat of any battle with Azula in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, launching on July 2 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.

Preorder on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424420/Avatar_Legends_The_Fighting_Game/

Wishlist on PS5: 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018989/

Wishlist on Xbox Series X|S: 
https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/avatar-legends-the-fighting-game/9ph2332vrwsf
title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game - Official Azula Developer Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond the Dome, an open-world sandbox RPG developed by ConchShip Games. Players will take on a journey of Chinese mythology and wuxia to explore eight distinct sects in 15 different regions of Shenzhou. Master the ways of martial arts, wield a variety of weapons, and pass the inner power to the next generation. The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond the Dome is launching on June 17 for PC (Steam).
title: The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond the Dome - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Window Trailer for Anima Song from the Abyss, a third-person Metroidvania hack-and-slash game developed by Anima Project. Players will embody two protagonists across an unforgiving world filled with mysteries of the elusive Abyss. Master unique abilities, take on powerful bosses, and unravel deep secrets from region to region. Anima Song from the Abyss is launching in 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Anima Song from the Abyss - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new teaser for Season 23 of Rocket League! The tournament is going global, in collaboration with the FIFA World Cup! 
We'll be eagerly anticipating more news when Season 23 of Rocket League races into the goal soon!
title: Rocket League - Official Season 23 Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Accolades Trailer for Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, a roguelite RTS developed by Alt Shift. With praise coming from all corners of the galaxy, Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes promises to deliver a tense narrative, complete with management sim elements to create the most authentic Battlestar Galactica experience possible! 

Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes is available now for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new look at the development of Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4. Hear from Infinity Ward directly as they touch on bringing the story to South Korea, the performance capture techniques used to bring the cast to life, the new characters coming to the narrative and of course, Captain Price's one-man war from the shadows. 

Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23rd 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official "From The Ward Ep.1" Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new trailer for Solarpunk, a first person cosy survival game from Rokaplay and Cyberware! High above the clouds, either solo or with friends, create your ideal community, grow food and design gadgets to aid you! 
Solarpunk will be available on PC (Steam, Epic, GoG), Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on June 8, 2026.
title: Solarpunk- Official Game Pass Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this behind the scenes look at Gothic Remake as the team take you through how they've evolved combat from the original! 

Gothic 1 Remake will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S June 5th.
title: Gothic 1 Remake - Official Making Of #6 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Developer Open Beta Overview for Hell Let Loose: Vietnam, a first-person action strategy shooter developed by Expression Games. Players will get the rundown with Paul Rustchynsky, Game Director, on what players can expect in the open beta. Head into the action now with the open beta for Hell Let Loose: Vietnam, running now through June 1 with the game launching on June 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam - Official Developer Open Beta Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Collaboration Area Trailer for Wuthering Waves, the hit free-to-play open-world action game developed by Kuro Games. Players will soon be able to explore Somnoire: Night City, a bustling concrete jungle region that's shrouded in eternal night, revealing a completely different cityscape. The Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Collaboration is launching into Wuthering Waves on June 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Wuthering Waves x Cyberpunk: Edgerunners - Official Collaboration Area Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Mina the Hollower is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, Humble, and GOG. Watch the Mina the Hollower launch trailer for this action-adventure game from the developers of Shovel Knight. Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower.
title: Mina the Hollower - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from LabyTrip Spirit in this trailer for the upcoming adventure puzzle-action game about a soul lost in the labyrinths of the afterlife. Work with friends to guide the spirit to ascension, or vie with other players toward the abyss. Be watchful, shrewd, and swift as you make your way through the changing labyrinths of limbo. LabyTrip Spirit will be available on PC.
title: Labytrip Spirit - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for Savara, an action-RPG roguelite from Ankama Games and Doryah Games. Step into the vibrant and colourful festival of Iop, the warrior god as you battle your way through the gauntlet of opponents. You will fall, but each time you get knocked down you will rise stronger than before, pumping points into an in-depth skill tree and arming your warrior with powerful new weapons and gear. 
Savara is out now for PlayStation 5 (Ps5), PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Savara - Official Launch Trailer
